verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents a first-party org-wide Dashboard covering review speed, code quality, collaboration patterns and the impact/ROI of AI reviews, with a companion page defining the review metrics. The evidence never names the story's specific metrics, so findings counts, suggestion acceptance rates and review coverage are only implied. missing for 10: explicit findings dashboards, documented suggestion acceptance-rate metrics, review-coverage metrics, independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I see dashboards of findings, acceptance rates, and review coverage across my org

citations.quote: The CodeRabbit Dashboard provides visibility into your team's review speed, code quality, collaboration patterns, and the impact of AI-assisted reviews.
Use the dashboard to track performance, identify bottlenecks, and measure the ROI of CodeRabbit across your organization.
